tools.name: check_counterparty
tools.description: Run a full pre-payment risk check on a payee: OFAC sanctions (names and wallets), domain age and email authentication, lookalike domains (vendor impersonation, brand typo-squats, executive impersonation), routing/IBAN/SWIFT/wallet validation, and business-email-compromise signals. Returns verdict pr

tools.name: screen_sanctions
tools.description: Screen a payee name (and optional crypto wallet) against OFAC sanctions lists and embargoed jurisdictions. Faster and cheaper than check_counterparty but does not detect fraud patterns. Costs $0.05 from the API key balance; without a key, the first 3 screens each day are free.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Show the remaining prepaid balance on the API key used for this connection. Free.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Confirm that a receipt returned by a previous check is authentic and unaltered. Free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_counterparty · Private data: check_counterparty, screen_sanctions, check_balance · Public sink: check_counterparty · Destructive: check_counterparty.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_counterparty · Private data: check_counterparty, screen_sanctions, check_balance · Public sink: check_counterparty · Destructive: check_counterparty

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
